components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form text input with focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #14121C; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; background: #FCFCFD; color: #14121C; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; border: 1px solid #E8E6ED; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7A7585; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #7C3AED; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(262 80% 55% / 0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F1F0F5; cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.html: PendingAcceptedCompleted

narrative.overview:
Donatio's visual system is a Community Canvas — a warm, approachable surface where generosity is visible, trusted, and celebrated. The aesthetic is refined, trustworthy, and precise, treating every interaction as a small act of care. The purple accent acts as a consistent thread of conviction, appearing sparingly to guide attention and signal action.

The system uses layered paper as its depth model: surfaces sit at consistent, gentle elevations with soft shadows at rest and subtle lifts on interaction. Everything feels tactile, settled, and deliberate — like well-designed stationery for a cause that matters.
keyCharacteristics: Clean, card-based layouts with generous whitespace
Purple as the single accent voice; neutral palette carries the bulk of the interface
Layered paper depth — shadows present at rest, lift on hover
Rounded but not overly playful forms (10px base radius)
DM Sans throughout — consistent weight and proportion across all scales
Gradients reserved for hero moments and the Donatio brand mark only

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet Trust appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its scarcity is what gives it power. When everything is accent, nothing is.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: DM Sans serves every role. No second font, no display face, no mono. Hierarchy is expressed through weight and size alone, not font switching.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Non-interactive surfaces have no shadow. Shadow is a signal: it means 'you can interact with this.'

dos: Do use Violet Trust sparingly — one primary action per view, one accent element per card.
Do keep all body text at Warm Slate or Deep Ink — never lighter than Warm Slate on white.
Do let cards breathe — 20px internal padding is the minimum.
Do use gradient-primary only on the brand logo, hero CTAs, and the landing page CTA section.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. Violet Trust is the single voice.
Don't use shadows on non-interactive surfaces — shadow means actionable.
Don't mix border radii — buttons use 10px, cards use 16px, pills use full. No intermediate values.
Don't place text directly on gradient backgrounds without sufficient contrast.
Don't use DM Sans below 400 weight or in italic.
